analysis:
The only changed file is docs/architecture/inference.md, and the changes are documentation-only. Head lines 25-171 add a large Nemotron Super section after "## Context", and head lines 868-869 are a small edit. Mode is unchanged and there are no code or config changes, so no control is altered in this PR.

The new text describes unregistered, internal-only native paths with no HTTP route or model registration. It also describes an optional local image HTTP hook that defaults to absent and has no production caller. It describes authenticated local application reuse, text-only binding, 429 refusal on queueFull, and rejection of media, tools and client prompt-cache keys. The shown base units (829-1195) are context only and were not modified in the visible ranges. I could not see the head text for 868-869.

Relevant threats: T-041 and TB-007 are touched by the documented Nemotron local text prefix cache (head 131-145). That cache is a resident recurrent checkpoint bank, enabled only with DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY=1. It uses a local unscoped cache scope, is reserved in the shared KV budget until native retirement, and has no SSD tier. T-041 says production never constructs a resident-RAM prefix cache. The doc describes this as an internal, unregistered, env-gated local owner, not a production coordinator path. If it is later wired into coordinator serving, T-041 and its "no RAM tier" statement would need updating, and the unscoped cache scope would have to be replaced by coordinator-authored cacheSalt. This is a future-review note, not a regression now.

The documented env knobs (DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_*) and the 64-request concurrency limit are bounded by admission (UnserviceableGrant) and 429. Image decode for PNG/JPEG applies container limits before raster allocation. Unverified: the implementation sources are not supplied, so these claims cannot be confirmed.
